nodes.statement: Differential on a tangent velocity is the velocity of the image curve.

nodes.region: printed35, extension and displayed chain rule (3.28)
nodes.statement: Replace the manifold map by its smooth ambient extension along the feasible curve and apply the ordinary chain rule.
The manifold differential is the ambient extension differential restricted to the tangent space.
Linear restriction establishes linearity and image velocity depends only on initial point and velocity.

nodes.region: printed35 question and printed36 first paragraph/display
nodes.statement: Two extensions give the same composed curve near the base time, hence the same derivative applied to its velocity.
The source already defines tangent velocities. The missing project adapter is not an author SOURCE_GAP and not a premise of the source proof.

nodes.region: printed35 extensions restrict F; printed36 first sentence
nodes.statement: Both ambient extensions restrict the same map; their compositions with any feasible curve agree locally.

nodes.region: printed35 last paragraph: already clear from (3.27)
nodes.statement: The definition of image-curve differential uses only the source map, so its value does not depend on which extension is chosen.

nodes.region: printed36 first paragraph and equality display
nodes.statement: The common composed curve has one velocity; the chain rule identifies it with each ambient differential on the same original curve velocity.
